summary: Focused retest of the 4 iteration_32 fixes on https://airyatra-corporate.preview.emergentagent.com. 3/4 FIXED: (a) /customer/carbon now renders CarbonCalculator component (no 404), (b) /contact now loads LandingPage (no 404), (c) Phone OTP mock mode works — SMS_MOCK_MODE=true confirmed, /api/auth/phone/send-otp → 200 with mock_otp:'123456', /api/auth/phone/verify-otp → 200 with access_token, user is redirected and logged in (Verify & Login button reachable, redirect to /admin as +919999999999 is mapped to vreadmin account). STILL BROKEN (1/4): (d) LoginPage does not surface any visible error toast/alert when credentials are wrong. Backend correctly returns HTTP 401 now (rate-limit 429 no longer the default response) — improved on iteration_32 — but the UI shows zero toast/alert/inline-error elements after the failed submit; form silently sits on /login with cleared inputs.

ui_bugs.issue: Wrong password produces backend 401 correctly, but no toast/alert/error element renders in the DOM (querySelectorAll for [class*=toast|alert|error] returns 0 matches after submit). User has no feedback that login failed. The iteration_32 fix for 401/429 error display appears not to have been applied or is not triggering — please verify LoginPage.js error handler for the 401 branch and confirm the toast library (sonner/react-hot-toast) is mounted and being called.

action_items: LoginPage.js: ensure the 401 catch branch calls toast.error(...) (or renders an inline alert) so the user sees 'Incorrect email or password'. Currently the network call fails silently in the UI. Verify <Toaster/> is mounted at app root and imported. Iteration_32 marked this as fixed but retest shows no visible feedback.
critical_code_review_comments: Login error UX regression pattern: backend semantics are correct (401 vs 429), but the frontend still swallows the error. Add an explicit test/assertion that a failed login renders a visible error element within 3s of submit.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (3/4 fixes verified end-to-end; login error toast still missing)

seed_data_creation: None; used existing accounts and mock phone +919999999999.
test_credentials: Used customer@airyatra.co.in / Customer@123 (login OK); admin@airyatra.co.in for wrong-password test (401 confirmed); +919999999999 mock OTP 123456 (verify → 200 token, redirect to /admin).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only remaining bug: LoginPage does not render a visible toast/alert when POST /api/auth/login returns 401. Backend is correct (returns 401 with error body); frontend handler is silent. Reproduce: goto /login, fill valid email + wrong password, click [data-testid=submit-btn], wait 3s, run document.querySelectorAll('[role=alert],[data-sonner-toast],[class*=toast]') — currently returns 0. Other fixes confirmed working; do not need re-verification unless code changes touch those areas.
rca_of_the_issue: LoginPage error branch for 401 either (i) does not invoke the toast function, (ii) invokes it before <Toaster/> is mounted, or (iii) throws before hitting the toast call. Inspect LoginPage.js handleLogin/onSubmit catch(err) — ensure toast.error(err.response?.data?.detail || 'Incorrect email or password') runs on status 401 and 429, and confirm a <Toaster position='top-right'/> exists in App.js or a layout above <LoginPage/>.
